description: This file provides formatting utilities for displaying key-value pairs, tags, and terminal output styling, with functions for colorizing, truncating, and styling text, likely used in command-line interfaces.

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Determines if the terminal supports rich formatting based on terminal capabilities and options.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified length using end padding.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Colorizes a key string if rich formatting is enabled.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Colorizes a value string if rich formatting is enabled.

methods.name: formatKeyValue
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair with optional rich styling.

methods.name: formatSeparator
methods.description: Creates a separator string (e.g., ' | ') with optional styling.

methods.name: formatTag
methods.description: Formats a tag string with styling based on its value.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if necessary.

ctags.name: formatKey
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatKey = (key: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.warn, key);$/

ctags.name: formatValue
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatValue = (value: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.info, value);$/

ctags.name: isRich
ctags.pattern: /^export const isRich = (opts?: { json?: boolean; plain?: boolean }) =>$/

ctags.name: pad
ctags.pattern: /^export const pad = (value: string, size: number) => value.padEnd(size);$/
